spec: design specs/WEIR_HUT.md (WEIR_HUT v0.1, Vincent Chi's weir hut at the Old Weir). Copy verbatim to data/detail_zz_weir_hut.json, then python3 tools/gen_mapdata.py. Build only after Vincent has seen specs/weir_hut_preview/ and said yes (rule 9).
status: DRAFT, not built. Every name and line is PLACEHOLDER for Story (D1591, D1594). Decisions D1590-D1599.
_about: One overlay, sorted after detail_hushwater: the new room hw_weir_hut_in; on hw_cut three grid rows, one addRoofs entry (the hut), a trimmed south-bank zone and five objects; objPatch re-gates the Wickerglen > Falls > Cut walk so the hut is reachable after Ilse's call (D1595), and keeps two Hall-2 holders out of the way until story.cobble_end. Flags and scene beats are owned by ACT1_KEEPER_JOIN; every flag here is a named placeholder for that packet. The room needs a new skin weir_hut (sprites.js) and the draft art in specs/weir_hut_art.json.

lines.else: Boots on the sack, please. The weir gets in everywhere.
Sketches of the glen, pinned in a ring. Red thread runs from each one to the same spot.

lines.story.chi_done: The thread now runs off the board, to a note that just says: FERNBROOK.
lines.else: More thread. Every line ends at a dot marked WICKERGLEN, NIGHT.
Notes in tidy pencil. Times, tracks, a moon drawn small. Nothing typed, nothing sent.
Notes in tidy pencil. Times, tracks, a moon drawn small. Nothing typed, nothing sent.
Three clean jars on the sill, lids on. Waiting.
One jar holds a leaf. Its tag gives a night, not a name.
A leaf, a feather. One jar for each Walkling the glen has lost.
Leaf, feather, leaf. The first shelf of jars is full.
Three more jars, empty. He hopes they stay that way.
Another leaf, another night. The tags are in his small hand.
Five jars filled now. He doesn't say the number out loud.
Every jar on the sill is full.
An old Keeper lantern, set apart on the shelf. A cloth is tied over its glass.
Company lamps, each with a paper tag. Put your ear close: a low hum.
A charcoal sketch of the glen at dusk. Small shapes walk toward a row of lights.
Paper files in a crate, tied with string. All of it written by hand.
A narrow cot, made up tight. It doesn't look slept in much.
A grey blanket, folded square. Old Keeper habits.
A squat stove. The kettle on top is always nearly boiling.
A sluice board. Weir water runs under the floor, loud enough to hide a quiet sound.
Water marks scratched in the post, years of them. A cord runs out to a bell by the path.
His boots, still wet. Yours are dripping on the sack beside them.

addObjs.deny: Barred from inside. A cord runs from the frame to a bell somewhere within.

lines.else: A plain oil lamp on a hook. No crest, no tag.
A rain barrel, full to the brim. A tin cup hangs off the side.
A net thrown over two crates to dry. It smells of the stream.

objPatch._note: D1595: the Wickerglen > Hushwater Falls > Hushwater Cut walk opens at Ilse's call (story.warden_met, owned by ACT1_KEEPER_JOIN), as well as at story.cobble_end. The rim stays shut until cobble_end. The two Hall-2 holders on that walk stay away until cobble_end.

linesFirst.else: The weir's south stones, old chisel marks and all. A hut is built right onto them.
